page_title: NEW 4-0 CRY | Newcastle v Crystal Palace 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A lofted cross from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

90+1' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Nick Pope anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the right side of the target.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
88' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
87' Substitution. Jefferson Lerma makes way for David Ozoh (Crystal Palace).
86' The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
86' The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.

86' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) strikes the ball towards the top left corner of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a superb save. The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Now Crystal Palace have a corner.

85' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tim Robinson no option but to blow his whistle. Crystal Palace win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
83' The ball is cleared after Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' Substitution. Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Joelinton walks off.
78' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
77' A fine pass finds Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Sam Johnstone reacts superbly to deny him.
75' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
75' The resulting corner from Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
75' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
74' The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will take a throw-in.
70' Today's match ends for Will Hughes who will be replaced by Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace).
70' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) replacing Callum Wilson.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Anthony Gordon will be replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Kieran Trippier can be given a rest.
69' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Bruno Guimaraes and he is replaced by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd).
66' 4 - 0 Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom left corner.
66' The Crystal Palace players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
61' Substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta is replaced by Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace).
60' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
60' The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
58' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) will deliver the corner kick.

58' A lofted pass picks out Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

56' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
55' Crystal Palace are ruled offside.
54' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
54' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
54' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
52' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tim Robinson signals.
48' An attempted cross from Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' The booking goes to Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).
45+5' The referee has issued a yellow card to Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
45+2' 3 - 0 Goal! Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
42' Newcastle control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
39' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
38' Newcastle take a short corner kick.

38' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
37' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd). Newcastle have a corner.
36' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

34' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
30' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and tries to prod home! Unluckily for his team, the ball crashes against the crossbar!
29' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
27' Good clearance! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.

26' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Sam Johnstone sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
24' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
23' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
20' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
19' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
18' Referee Tim Robinson sees the trip by Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
14' Neat passing move from Crystal Palace in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
11' Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
7' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

4' Referee Tim Robinson points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Newcastle players celebrate. It's in the back of the net! Kieran Trippier plays it into the box, and Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:0.
4' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) scores a goal, but Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
3' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) has a goal ruled out for offside!
2' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
1' The match has just started.
Newcastle will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Tim Robinson.
